message: expected `endmodule` to close module `{name}` opened at {opened}, found {found}
description: The file ends before the `endmodule` that closes the module named. Often an earlier unclosed `begin` or an unclosed comment has swallowed it.
actions: Add `endmodule` at the end of the module.
If `endmodule` is there, look for an unclosed `begin` or `/*` before it.
